correctness.rationale: The Nyström residual on the unobserved coordinates is the inverse of the complementary precision block, and the landmark covariance determinant is the complementary precision determinant divided by the full precision determinant. Each gap gives a Dirichlet path block with determinant sinh((m+1)θ)/sinh θ for m=g−1. Its logarithmic μ-derivative is strictly convex as a function of m because z coth z is strictly convex on z>0; the log determinant is strictly concave. Unit smoothing therefore gives precisely the shared balanced equality cases, including k=1 and k=n with the empty-block convention. The full precision determinant is (exp(nθ)−1)(1−exp(−nθ)); counting rooted cyclic compositions and dividing by k gives the labelled census. For n=kq with 2≤k<n and q≥2, the predecessor of the constant gap vector under strict smoothing has gaps q−1,q+1,q,…,q, so it gives exactly the best strict alternatives for both objectives; the continuant Wronskian gives the stated determinant ratio. Independent arithmetic at n=4, k=2, μ=1 gives excess 1/12, determinant ratio 8/9 and four runner-up subsets. The reported bounded checker was inspected, not executed, and does not prove the all-parameter statement.
